en.hubeali: And from him, from Sayf Bin Umeyra, from Mansour Bin Hazim, from Salim Al Ashalli who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the prey of the trained dog who has eaten from the prey. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Eat from it’.
